faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about biubiu.tools. Can't find what you're looking for? Reach out to our community.

items.question: What is biubiu.tools?
items.answer: biubiu.tools is a toolkit designed for batch on-chain operations. It automates batch transfers, asset sweeping, and more through smart contracts, saving you significant time and gas fees. Works on Ethereum and all EVM-compatible chains.

items.question: Is this tool secure?
items.answer: Your private keys never leave your browser - all signing operations are performed locally. We don't store any sensitive data, and our code is 100% open source for you to audit anytime.

items.question: How can I verify the tool's security?
items.answer: Visit our GitHub repository to review the complete source code. You can also self-host your own instance, or inspect browser network requests to confirm your keys are never transmitted.

items.question: Which blockchain networks are supported?
items.answer: We support Ethereum and 20+ EVM-compatible chains including BSC, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Avalanche, and more. You can also add custom RPC networks.

items.question: Which wallets are supported?
items.answer: We support MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase Wallet, and other major wallets. You can also import private keys directly (processed locally only, never uploaded).

items.question: What advantages does this have over similar tools?
items.answer: 100% open source and auditable, private keys processed locally, gas-optimized smart contracts, and transparent pricing. Permissionlessly supports any EVM-compatible chain without waiting for official integration.

items.question: How are fees calculated?
items.answer: Fee = Network Gas + Protocol Fee. Protocol fees vary by operation type, typically a small amount of native token. Membership removes protocol fees, making it more economical for heavy users.

items.question: What's the difference between Pay-Per-Use and Membership?
items.answer: Pay-Per-Use charges a protocol fee per operation, ideal for occasional use. Membership provides unlimited access to all tools with no protocol fees during the validity period, typically saving 50%+ for frequent users.

items.question: What's included in the Membership?
items.answer: Members get unlimited access to all tools on the purchased chain (including premium query tools), zero protocol fees, and priority support. Membership is per-chain - cross-chain use requires separate purchases.

items.question: Can I deploy it myself?
items.answer: Absolutely! The code is fully open source and you can deploy it to any EVM chain. Self-hosted versions have zero protocol fees, perfect for developers and technical teams. See the deployment docs in our GitHub repository.

items.question: How do I get started?
items.answer: 1) Connect your wallet; 2) Select the target network; 3) Choose your tool; 4) Follow the prompts. No registration required - start using immediately.

items.question: How can I get help if I have issues?
items.answer: Join our Telegram community for real-time support. For technical issues or feature requests, submit an Issue on GitHub. We typically respond within 24 hours.
